mgt-yolo11-n.description: The smallest and fastest model in the MGT YOLO11 series. Ideal for devices with limited resources or applications where speed is critical.

mgt-yolo11-s.description: A compact model balancing speed and accuracy. Suitable for real-time where high performance is needed without significant loss of precision.

mgt-yolo11-m.description: A medium model optimized for higher accuracy while maintaining acceptable speed. Perfect for tasks where reliability is important and processing moderate data volumes.

mgt-yolo11-l.description: A large model with high object detection accuracy.

mgt-yolo11-x.description: The largest and most accurate model in the MGT YOLO11 series.
